pageProps.title: San Churro QV Melbourne
pageProps.review: Popped into a churros spot for a break. Dipped warm churros into deep chocolate and enjoyed a leisurely moment. I'm not really a dessert connoisseur so I can't say whether it was exceptional, but it was tasty enough to enjoy.
